description: This file defines the NotificationsHandler class for managing device notifications within an Android application. It includes interfaces and classes for handling notification snapshots, executing notification actions, and converting data to JSON format.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: An interface for providing notification state, supporting reading snapshots, requesting rebinds, and executing actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: A singleton object implementing NotificationsStateProvider to interact with system notification listener service.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class handling notification listing and actions, with methods to process JSON parameters, interact with the notification state provider, and generate JSON responses.

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Handles request to list current notifications and returns the snapshot as JSON wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Handles notification actions such as open, dismiss, reply based on input JSON parameters.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads the notification snapshot and rebinds the service if necessary.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a DeviceNotificationSnapshot to a JSON string.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, handling errors.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Utility method to extract a trimmed string value from a JsonObject by key.
